glusterd_working_dir.description: Path to the working directory where GlusterFS stores its metadata and state files.

glusterd_listen_port.description: TCP port on which the GlusterFS management daemon listens for incoming connections from other nodes and clients.

glusterd_transport_type.description: Transport type used for communication between GlusterFS daemons; typically 'tcp' or 'rdma'.

glusterd_bind_address.description: IP address (or hostname) the management daemon binds to. Use a specific IP for multi-homed hosts or '0.0.0.0' to bind all interfaces.

glusterd_options.description: Additional key-value configuration options for the management daemon (e.g., 'rpc-auth-allow-insecure', 'cli-timeout'). Each key is the option name, each value is the value (string or number).
